description:
In crates/imap/src/session/mailbox.rs, handle_list executes SELECT username, mailbox FROM imap_uid_validity WHERE username = ? which returns all mailboxes for the user, then filters rows using the IMAP LIST pattern via glob_match in Rust. For users with many mailboxes this is O(n) over the full mailbox set regardless of the specificity of the LIST pattern.

Fix: for simple non-wildcard patterns push an exact equality predicate into the SQL WHERE clause. For patterns without a '%' hierarchy separator, a LIKE clause or a prefix comparison can eliminate most rows at the database level. The Rust-side glob_match can remain as a post-filter for the rows that pass the SQL pre-filter.
title: imap: handle_list loads all mailboxes then filters in Rust
